I am an environmental economist and postdoctoral researcher at the University of Bonn (Institute for Food and Resource Economics).

My research focuses on land-use dynamics, environmental policies, and the co-benefits of forest conservation. Methodologically, I combine spatial data science in R with empirical impact evaluation to study policy outcomes at scale.

You can find my working papers and publications on the [Research](research.qmd) page, or view my full academic record in my [CV](cv.pdf).
